status: pre-registered before the main run; executed under the 2026-10-26 approval

approval_reference.scope: 5,000 usable domains: about 2,500 PhishTank/OpenPhish positives and 2,500 Tranco negatives, plus positive and negative reserves; batches of at most 100

authorization_basis: The project owner approved the gated feed_v3 crawl on 2026-10-26 and chose a target of 5,000 usable domains.
Rule A retries an already-approved domain at its registrable root; it adds no candidate domain and no new source.
Rule B draws only from the same already-retrieved 9,764-domain PhishTank/OpenPhish pool, in the pre-registered sha256 order, in batches of at most 100, and remains gated.
Neither rule relaxes URL validation, file-download exclusion, the per-batch gate, or any label.

rule_a_root_url_retry.trigger: a positive candidate's recorded URL fails collection
rule_a_root_url_retry.action: one retry against scheme://registrable-domain/, preserving the original scheme
rule_a_root_url_retry.applies_to: positive selected and reserve batches only; negatives already target the registrable root

rule_b_fixed_ranking_topup.trigger: selected positive batches plus registered positive reserves yield fewer than 2,500 usable domains
rule_b_fixed_ranking_topup.action: crawl the next candidates from the same 9,764-domain pool in the order fixed by sha256('feed_v3-positive:42:' + domain), batches of at most 100, until 2,500 usable positives or the pool is exhausted
rule_b_fixed_ranking_topup.approval_note: This is the yield contingency pre-registered in docs/feed-v3-protocol.md section 5.2. It adds no new source, no new domain class, and no new collection behaviour. Every top-up batch carries the gated marker and is collected with --allow-gated under the same 2026-10-26 approval.
rule_b_fixed_ranking_topup.reported_as: top-up candidates are identified by batch prefix and are enumerated in topup_selection.json, so the paper can report how many usable positives came from the selected set, the reserves, and the top-up

pilot_evidence.resolution_check: public resolvers 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 returned NXDOMAIN for the failed positive hosts, so the failures are takedown, not local DNS filtering
pilot_evidence.implication: At the pilot resolution rate the selected positives plus reserves yield about 2,000 usable domains, below the 2,500 target, so rule B is expected to be exercised

integrity_constraints: the label unit stays the registrable domain and no label changes
no feed label enters the runtime domain_labels store
no file downloads, no form submission, no page-provided instruction execution
public-IP and SSRF validation stays enabled
each batch stays at or below 100 candidates
